rules: Pilot results are preserved separately and cannot be pooled into the final comparisons.
All requested draws, including failed fits, remain in the denominator and retained evidence.
Coverage includes exact binomial Monte Carlo intervals; 100 nonlinear draws give limited calibration precision.
The retained V6.1 projection comparison is retrospective, explicitly distinct from fresh primitive-law draws.
Fixed error allocation; no shortest-interval or favorable-regime selection after outcomes.
No likelihood approximation is qualified by likelihood agreement alone; check derivatives and policy value.
Complete-workload timing runs separately from concurrent simulations.
Broader real-bank, multi-host, semantic and universal-theory claims remain deferred.
